requirements.text: An annual stress testing programme approved by the Management Board describes the stress tests, their purpose, scope, frequency, methodologies, responsibilities and use of results.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of the Management Board; evidenced in the approved stress testing programme, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: The Management Board is involved in defining the ICAAP adverse scenario and reverse stress test outcome, and the use of results in strategic, capital and risk appetite decisions is documented.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of the Management Board; evidenced in Management Board minutes and ICAAP documentation, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Stress test results are used in risk appetite limits, capital planning, the management buffer, recovery plan indicators and, for the baseline, IFRS 9 forward-looking information.
requirements.level_reason: Institution-wide use of stress test results; evidenced in risk appetite, capital planning and recovery plan documentation, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Scenarios are severe but plausible and address the Bank's material risks and vulnerabilities identified in the annual risk identification process.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Each scenario has a written narrative explaining triggering events and transmission, and the quantified variable paths are consistent with that narrative.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Adverse scenario severity is calibrated against historical episodes and hypothetical events, documenting the percentile or historical analogue of each key variable.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: The scenario generation model ensures consistency between variables, and expert adjustments to model-generated paths are documented and approved under MRM-STD-023.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Scenarios cover at least GDP, unemployment, residential and commercial real estate prices, the interest rate term structure, credit spreads, equity prices, exchange rates and inflation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Each satellite model documents its macro linkage: the economic rationale, expected sign and lag structure of every explanatory variable.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Explanatory variables in satellite models are statistically significant with the expected sign; variables with counter-intuitive signs are not retained.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Satellite model development data cover at least one full economic cycle including a downturn, or the representativeness of external or proxy data is justified.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Satellite models are tested under scenario values outside the historical data range, and the treatment of implausible extrapolation is documented.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Satellite model performance is assessed out of sample and out of time, including a back-test of projections under realised historical macroeconomic paths.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: A benchmark or challenger model is maintained for every Tier 1 satellite model, and the champion-challenger difference under the adverse scenario is reported as model uncertainty.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: The same satellite model is used where a risk parameter is projected for stress testing, IFRS 9 and ICAAP, and purpose-driven differences are documented.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Second-round and feedback effects, such as rating migration on RWA and rate paths on prepayment and deposit behaviour, are captured or their omission justified.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Management actions are credible, feasible and documented with expected impact and implementation time, and results are reported before and after management actions.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of the Bank's stress testing programme; evidenced in the stress test results report, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: A reverse stress test is performed at least annually at Group level and identifies the scenarios leading to a breach of the total SREP capital requirement and to non-viability.
requirements.level_reason: Group-level obligation of the stress testing programme; evidenced in the reverse stress test report, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: The plausibility of reverse stress test scenarios is assessed and the results are used to challenge the business model, recovery plan indicators and adverse scenario severity.
requirements.level_reason: Group-level obligation of the stress testing programme; evidenced in the reverse stress test report and its use in management decisions, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.article: ERM-STD-300 §9.1; ECB Guide to the ICAAP, Principles 3 and 7
requirements.text: The ICAAP normative perspective includes at least a baseline and an adverse scenario over three years, projecting material risks, own funds and capital ratios against requirements and buffers.
requirements.level_reason: ICAAP obligation of the institution; evidenced in the ICAAP normative perspective documentation, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models used in the ICAAP only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2). Normative perspective (Principle 3) and stress testing (Principle 7) of the ECB ICAAP Guide (2018).

requirements.text: Limitations of stress test models used in the ICAAP are reflected through documented adjustments or capital add-ons.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models used in the ICAAP only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Climate scenarios are based on recognised reference pathways and include at least an orderly transition, a disorderly transition and a hot-house-world scenario, adapted to the Bank's portfolios.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to climate scenario and climate risk models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Climate scenario analysis covers a short-term ICAAP horizon and a long-term horizon of at least ten years, and explicitly identifies its transmission channels.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to climate scenario and climate risk models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Short-term climate stress test results are incorporated into the ICAAP adverse scenario where climate risk is material under CER-POL-001.
requirements.level_reason: ICAAP obligation of the institution; evidenced in the ICAAP scenario documentation, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to climate scenario and climate risk models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).

requirements.text: Baseline projections for the first projection year are compared with realised outcomes after each ICAAP cycle, and material deviations are analysed and reported.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (ERM-STD-300 v2.2).
